confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge; no live menus, listings, or booking pages were checked. Beer, café, and meal anchors are the most reliable. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because they vary by season and neighborhood, and July is peak beach season. Cocktail (about 2.75x draft beer) and wine glass (about 2.25x) are set relative to beer because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX value comes from a search-tool summary attributed to the RBA overview page. I did not open that page, and no independent corroboration was found, so verify against the RBA F11.1 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Reasoned from general knowledge of South Korean price levels: Busan is priced below Seoul and in the range of other mid-sized East Asian port cities. Accommodation assumes July peak-season demand. No comparable-city listings were consulted.
